scope: Proposition 7.3 (Local constancy of the semistable type) of the manuscript “Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields” (preprints/Modularity-of-elliptic-curves-over-imaginary-quadratic-fields-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 030 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c74cc37755f500be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let L0 be a local field, let X be a smooth L0-variety, and let A → X be an abelian scheme of relative dimension g. For x0 ∈ X(L0), there exist a finite extension L/L0 and an analytic neighborhood N ⊂ X(L0) of x0 with the following properties. For every x ∈ N, the abelian variety Ax is semistable over L and has the same toric rank as Ax0 over L. If Ax0 has good reduction over L, then Ax has the same Newton polygon over L. In particular, if Ax0 ≃ Eg 0 for an elliptic curve E0/L0, every sufficiently nearby fiber has, after the same finite extension, the same one of the following three properties as Eg 0 : 1. good ordinary reduction; 2. good reduction with all Newton slopes equal to 1/2; 3. semistable reduction of toric rank g.
